draft_spec.name: VEX V5 robot, team 404S - photo draft
draft_spec.description: Photo draft (all dimensions ESTIMATED) of team 404S's VEX V5RC robot: omni-wheel tank base, green-gear intake tower, pneumatic cylinder and two air tanks. Sizes assume it fills most of the 18 in V5RC starting size; motor count and gearing are not visible and are guesses.

validation.note: validate() checks physical coherence of the ESTIMATED draft; a PASS means the draft is self-consistent, not that it matches the real robot

findings.message: every dimension in this spec is ESTIMATED from a photo, not measured — the checks ran against estimates, so this is not a verdict on the real robot; confirm the dimensions before trusting the spec
